en.headline: 7 own commits across three repos, plus 16 automated commits by
en.summary: Work centered on three repositories, with **7 own commits** plus 16 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` (5 commits), docs were updated to drop references to removed documents, plans were moved into `.openchamber/plans`, a Steps checklist was added with fixed cross-references, line endings were unified to LF, and the `skill_management` spec got a revision plus a feasibility evaluation. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` received 1 commit adding an `opencode-provider` knowledge category covering catalog three-tier sources, credential ownership, endpoints, and OpenChamber governance. `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` received 1 commit on AI failure visibility, model labeling, and a redesigned 30-day summary. On `openchamber/openchamber` I commented on issue #4939 about the selection menu not opening on rendered pages, and started discussion #5114 proposing to split that fix into a frame→host selection bridge first. Three issues there were closed by btriapitsyn (#4896, #4920, #4601), and I received replies on #4601 (fix confirmed in 7d037b07d) and #4899 (not reproduced). Totals: 7 commits, 0 PRs, 1 issue touched, 0 reviews; no releases were published.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 7 次本人提交，另有 16 次自动提交
zh.summary: 当天工作集中在三个仓库，共 **7 次本人提交**，另有 16 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 有 5 次提交：删除已移除文档的引用，计划改存到 `.openchamber/plans`，补充 Steps 清单并修正交叉引用，统一换行符为 LF，`skill_management` 规范修订版加上可行性评测。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 1 次提交新增 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涵盖 catalog 三层来源、凭据归属、端点与 OpenChamber 管辖。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 1 次提交改进 AI 失败可见性、模型标注与 30 天总结改版。在 `openchamber/openchamber`，我对 issue #4939（渲染页面内选中文字不弹出评论菜单）发表了评论，并发起讨论 #5114，建议先把该修复拆成 frame→host 选择桥。该仓库另有 3 个 issue 由 btriapitsyn 关闭（#4896、#4920、#4601），我在 #4601（已在 7d037b07d 修复）和 #4899（未能复现）收到回复。总计 7 次提交、0 个 PR、1 个 issue 参与、0 次评审，无新发布。
